method: All 12 history placements and six matched baseline/probe-only failures read from sealed v0.3 evidence. Event snapshots use t/20ms row mapping. Probe statistics inclusive endpoints. No thresholds changed or new integrated episodes run.
important_limits: μ·ΣN is a flat-side Coulomb capacity approximation, not a measured tangential wrench or global proof that all grasps are infeasible.
Recorded normal forces omit contacts ≤.01N; small force contributions below that logging threshold are not included.
This is a limitation of pinned position-servo settings + side-pinch geometry, not evidence of PiPER hardware weakness.
Existing 12-scene cohort is known development evidence for v0.4, not fresh confirmation.
